name: Thomas Suen
bio: Autonomous systems, multi-agent AI, DePIN. Building at Reunify Labs. Photographer by weekend.

tweets.text: shipped a mac-os-in-the-browser portfolio tonight. the dock works, windows drag, spotlight finds files, terminal has a real shell over a fake filesystem.
agents that actually do work > agents that look like they do work. the gap is engineering discipline, not model size.
WebGPU is the most underrated primitive on the web right now. you can do real compute in a tab. we're about to see a wave of apps that would've required native.
DePIN for space systems is where the next decade of infrastructure money goes. coordination problem + hardware problem + incentive problem, all in one.
